## File: huggingface_transformers/examples/quantization/custom_quantization_int8_example.py

Prompts

```
['create an INT8 symmetric linear layer with configurable in/out features and bias', 'replace nn.Linear layers in a model with INT8 symmetric quantized layers', 'define an INT8 symmetric quantization config with modules to not convert', 'build a quantizer that converts model weights to INT8 symmetric format', 'quantize a causal language model with INT8 symmetric quantization and generate text']
```

```
{'create_int8_symmetric_linear_layer': 'create an INT8 symmetric linear layer with configurable in/out features and bias', 'replace_model_linear_layers': 'replace nn.Linear layers in a model with INT8 symmetric quantized layers', 'define_int8_symmetric_config': 'define an INT8 symmetric quantization config with modules to not convert', 'build_int8_symmetric_quantizer': 'build a quantizer that converts model weights to INT8 symmetric format', 'quantize_and_generate_text': 'quantize a causal language model with INT8 symmetric quantization and generate text'}
```
